Set_v2 ladder · prompt comparison

Simple prompts vs v2 prompts

Same 40 tasks, seeds, budgets and model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, cloud.ru). The only change: SWARM_PROMPT_STYLE=simple — short plain instructions and a blunt “DO NOT SOLVE ANY PROBLEM NOW. DON'T EVEN TRY.” during distribution. One swarm + one private control per rung in each run; no uncertainty bands.

22,291 → 4,552longest distribution reasoning of one agent, tokens
4 → 0distribution turns that compute (≥ 50 “=” signs)
-0.018…+0.010swarm − private R during solving, simple prompts
372 → 293 ₽generation ledger, 8 runs

Summary

  • The blunt ban works: no distribution turn computes any more (4 → 0 turns with ≥ 50 “=” signs); the longest distribution reasoning fell from 22,291 to 4,552 tokens. Long distribution turns now deliberate about the choice, not the problem.
  • Side effect for the measurement: distribution is now so short that at W=200 only 3 ten-author distribution windows exist (was 21); at W=400 there are none on any rung, so the distribution-vs-solving contrast can be measured only at small windows.
  • Solving: swarm and private curves stay close on every rung (swarm − private R between -0.018 and +0.010 over W=100/200/400), as with the v2 prompts.
  • Correctness is about the same: swarm 38/40 → 37/40, private 38/40 → 38/40.
  • Chat became shorter: distribution messages are 7–16 tokens (were 23–51); “one sentence” is taken literally.
  • Few distribution windows: at W=100 the number of ten-author distribution windows per rung fell from 7/6/8/27 to 3/4/4/2, so the distribution − solving contrast now rests on 2–4 windows per rung and is noisy (rung 4 is no longer near zero).
  • Reliability: interrupted provider calls 35/240 → 18/228; explicit restart turns 10 → 0. Generation ledger 372 → 293 ₽.

Next steps

  • Keep the simple prompts: they remove solving from distribution, and correctness is about the same (section 2).
  • Decide how to measure the distribution phase now that it is short: smaller windows, the chat payload channel, or asking for a longer distribution message (e.g. 3–5 sentences on why this problem) so that the chat carries text.
  • Repeat groups (several swarm/private pairs per rung) are needed before any claim about differences; fix provider interruptions first.

Scope and sources

Runs: artifacts/pipeline-ladder-v2 (v2 prompts) and artifacts/pipeline-ladder-v2-simple (simple prompts), seeds 3/82/83/84, tasks artifacts/pipeline-ladder-v2/items. Generation ledger: v2 372.19 ₽, simple 292.86 ₽ (simple: 214.11 ₽ usage-backed + 78.75 ₽ unreceipted estimates for interrupted calls). Figure embeddings, simple run: 1048 requests, $0.1182 by receipts. Built by scripts/build_prompt_comparison_report.py from saved files only; numbers in prompt-comparison.json.
